A brave boy and a great warrior seek the ring of ultimate power.

We were amazing. We are amazing.

35309: Tokyo engineer Kariya arrives on a primitive tropical island, where he interacts with the Futori clan, to drill a well to power a sugar mill.

Half man - Half beast - Trapped in a world forgotten by time!
35821: Raja Saab, a politician, falsely accuses Shyam, a patriotic young man, of being a terrorist, prompting the latter to take an unlikely route to revenge.

They're a couple of zeros short of a grand
36333: When Xu Lai goes on vacation with his wife and extended family, he gets a chance to meet his former lover. However, his brother-in-law foils his plans and he becomes a suspect in a murder case.

The film was over. The story had only started.
37357: Lalu is a reckless youth who is willing to do anything for money, even if it means getting involved in the drugs business.

Don't Lie, Don't Cheat, And Don't Be Afraid!

Ignore her, and she'll never go away.

39661: Chinese detective Charlie Chan solves a murder linked to the occult.

40173: Offering a caustic immersion into the lives of disaffected junior high students on the cusp of adulthood, the film takes place over the 5-day period before, during, and after a ferocious, seemingly liberating typhoon, which six of the students endure while marooned in their school.
We're in the gym at midnight, we're in the eye of the typhoon!

The true story of a boy... a girl... and the movie that changed everything.

Someone Wants To Say Something To Someone

What is the force behind these brutalities? Is it natural or supernatural?

Somewhere in the DARK a Bullet Drilled Home !
42733: Armin, in his fourties, is a freelancer with lots of time and little money. He’s not really happy, but can’t picture living a different life. One morning the world looks the same as always, but mankind has disappeared.

43757: A small British army team is sent deep behind enemy lines to destroy a German petrol dump as part of the preparation for a major attack in the North African campaign. Sea of Sand was distributed in the US in a shortened version, Desert Patrol.

Pappayude Swantham Appoos movie is all about the bonds between the father and his son.
44269: Little coastal town is being terrorized by deadly Barracudas.
You Can Almost Hear The Screams! as the water below becomes a CHURNING DEATHBED of FLASHING TEARING TEETH!

Luis Fernando Frías de la Parra

Criminal Masterminds? Don't Bank On It.

ADVENTURE AS FIERY AND FURIOUS AS THE FLAMING SANDS OF CHINA'S GOBI DESERT!
45293: Claire is approached by the father of her murdered childhood friend to help investigate the haunted moor he believes is his son's final resting place.
Out there, we are all lost.

Adventure ... raging to the very peaks of Excitement !

47341: Aravindan, Chandu and Joy are best friends. Their friendship faces a testing time when Aravindan's sister falls in love with Chandu.

By winter, the boy is back in the house and Belli is pregnant. Soon her parents must know.
a story of love without bonds.

To find himself, he will have to risk it all.

She Was a Wonderful Sweetheart...But a Terrible Enemy!

David then agrees to a plot by a bank board member to inflate his bank's stock and sell short — just before the market crashes.
A Drama That Soars Half Way to Heaven and Reaches Half Way to Hell!

At Last On The Screen! The Mighty Story Of The World-Famous COMMANDOS!

The Man Joan Loves---Loves Her! But Marriage Never Entered His Head!

And can any one of them survive a night in the woods?

What if the real weight to lose was your complexes?
Dr. Hachemi, le médecin du centre

The cat and mouse chase never ends!

The true story you should know.

Offscreen, Dame Judi Dench recites a sequence of Shakespeare's sonnets that counterpoint the action. Jarman called it, “My most austere work, but also the closest to my heart.”
